tests.name: Same letters, different counts
tests.hint: Each letter must appear the same number of times.

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(242)
pairs = []
for _ in range(40):
    a = ''.join(random.choices('abc', k=random.randint(0, 6)))
    b = ''.join(random.sample(a, len(a))) if random.random() < 0.5 else ''.join(random.choices('abc', k=len(a)))
    pairs.append((a, b))
tests.expr: [is_anagram(a, b) for a, b in pairs]
